name: id
description: The ID of the action link.

name: text
description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the action link. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: html
description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the action link. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire action link component in a `call` block.

name: type
description: Type of action link as a button – `"button"` or `"submit"`. Defaults to `"submit"` unless `href` is provided.

name: href
description: The action link `href` attribute. If set, the action link will use an `<a>` tag automatically unless `type` is provided.

name: openInNewWindow
description: If set to `true`, then the action link will open in a new window. If `type` is set, this has no effect.

name: variant
description: Optional variant of action link. You can use only `"reverse"` or empty values with this option.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the action link component.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the action link component.
